form: One signed lead opinion after plenary review, with distinct mental-state, managerial punitive-agency/compliance, broader-agency/burden reservation, common disposition and application portions. Separate Stone concurrence, Thomas concurrence in part/dissent, and Stevens concurrence in part/dissent in part joined by Souter, Ginsburg and Breyer.
form_legal_basis: Different direct proposition coalitions and competing remedy positions require precise partial joins; one author can carry all portions, and no division changes eligibility or counts.

governing_propositions.I: M1-M2 statutory mental state and submission/award distinctions; eight join, Thomas independently accepts M2 distinctions.
governing_propositions.II-A_and_II-B: Five direct supporters of managerial actual-authority/scope attribution and bounded actual-good-faith compliance protection, without paper-policy immunity or displacement of own company wrongdoing.
governing_propositions.II-C: Four non-Stone agency supporters preserve full Restatement reference framework and reserve universal compliance burden allocation; no Stone join or general Court holding on every unused route.
governing_propositions.III-A: Eight-Justice common vacatur and remand, preserving liability/backpay and no present punitive award.
governing_propositions.III-B: Four-Justice ordinary application position; no present judicial determination compelling punitive trial.
governing_propositions.Stevens_separate: Four-Justice punitive-trial direction and refusal to adopt new agency/compliance limit here, not a categorical anti-compliance holding.
governing_propositions.Stone_separate: Employer avoids managerial vicarious punishment only by showing contrary action against meaningful reasonably designed actually implemented good-faith efforts; no added proof standard.
governing_propositions.Thomas_separate: Affirm withholding under additional aggravated-culpability construction; alternative agency support not remand vote.

assignment.basis: Fit: her Hazen Paper opinion performs the central distinction between intentional conduct and knowing/reckless illegality without extra outrage; her frozen Meritor-based punitive-agency position supports every lead proposition. She and Kennedy have the same count and no unresolved join barrier.
